primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: Agent tools can be auto-approved, disabled, or routed through explicit approval, and rejected tools should let the agent adjust rather than loop.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: OpenClaude records a denied protected action as a trace event and requires a safe alternative instead of executing the action.

primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: Agent code execution should be tied to an explicit sandbox/provider model with isolation tradeoffs documented.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: OpenClaude keeps VS Code/PATH/install-state mutation outside the local no-provider fixture and records it as a protected boundary.

primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: Agent security guidance separates sandboxing, permissions, and approval boundaries from normal task execution.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: OpenClaude records approval absence as a first-class denial reason and keeps protected execution false.

primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: The open-source Codex repository points users to sandboxing and approval documentation as part of its security model.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: OpenClaude binds its protected-action denial fixture to the same sandbox/approval evidence family without running a protected action.

traceChecks.label: operator authorization is bounded to local no-provider denial trace capture

claimBoundary: Protected-action denial trace capture is local no-provider fixture evidence only. It does not call providers, live models, external services, mutate protected repositories, repair VS Code/PATH/install state, publish, deploy, launch, or authorize release, production, public, external-validation, benchmark-superiority, or autonomous-reliability claims.
